title: RESHPart: Feedback-Reshaped Spectral Embedding for Hypergraph Partitioning
abstract: arXiv:2611.05729v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: With scalable Laplacian solvers now available, the next frontier is to exploit them more effectively for high-quality hypergraph partitioning. In this work, we revisit spectral hypergraph partitioning from the perspective of spectral embedding geometry. Through a systematic analysis of circuit hypergraphs and controlled synthetic (hyper)graphs, we identify a ray-like embedding structure that helps explain the effectiveness of projection-based partitioning. We further show that the geometry of spectral embeddings can be systematically influenced through Laplacian design and hyperedge reweighting. Guided by these insights, we propose FRESHPart, a feedback-reshaped spectral partitioning framework that refines the spectral embedding through Geometry Feedback and Search Feedback, producing embeddings that are better aligned with projection-based partitioning. On the Titan23 benchmark, FRESHPart achieves average cut reductions over hMETIS of 1

translated_title: RESHPart：面向超图划分的反馈重塑谱嵌入
translated_abstract: 随着可扩展的拉普拉斯求解器的出现，下一个前沿是如何更有效地利用它们以获得高质量的超图划分。在本工作中，我们从谱嵌入几何的视角重新审视谱超图划分。通过对电路超图和受控合成（超）图的系统性分析，我们识别出一种射线状（ray-like）嵌入结构，这有助于解释基于投影的划分方法的有效性。我们进一步表明，谱嵌入的几何结构可以通过拉普拉斯矩阵设计和超边重加权被系统地影响。基于这些见解，我们提出了FRESHPart，一个通过几何反馈和搜索反馈来精化谱嵌入的反馈重塑谱划分框架，从而产生与基于投影的划分更加对齐的嵌入。在Titan23基准测试上，FRESHPart 相比 hMETIS 实现了平均割的降低（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出FRESHPart框架，从谱嵌入几何出发，通过几何反馈和搜索反馈重塑谱嵌入，使其更有利于基于投影的超图划分，并在Titan23基准上相比hMETIS显著降低割值。
en_tdlr: FRESHPart reshapes spectral embeddings through geometry and search feedback to align them with projection-based partitioning, achieving significant cut reductions over hMETIS on the Titan23 benchmark.
